thread:
samantha: FYI customer hitting intermittent `embedding.dim_mismatch` errors on /v1/embeddings when traffic hits batches > 8. Model: embed-1-large@v2. Error shows expected 1536 got 1024. Attaching repro notes.

ashwin: which model variant exactly? any quantized variants in the mix?

samantha: they pin `embed-1-large@v2` but also run `embed-1-quant` in the same service. Dynamic batching configured (max_batch_size: 64). Failures happen at tail under burst and high queue coalescing.

miranda: can you paste a minimal request + headers and any runtime logs you have?

samantha: sample request:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "input": ["query text"], "model": "embed-1-large@v2" }
```
Headers: `x-client-version: searcher/2.1.0`, `content-type: application/json`.

ashwin: runtime logs excerpt: 
```
[2026-05-03T14:01:22Z] batch_id=842 expected_dim=1536 actual_dim=1024 acceptor=embed_worker_3
[2026-05-03T14:01:22Z] traceback: ValueError: embedding dim mismatch
```

samantha: tail latency spikes line up exactly with those dimension errors. Hypothesis: dynamic batch coalescing mixes requests for quantized (1024) and full (1536) variants on the same GPU worker. Worker assumes consistent output dim and fails.

kai: do we validate model output-dim during enqueue? I thought we only check model name/alias. If alias points to different artifacts meta could differ.

miranda: customer said traffic pattern changed around midnight (search service ramp). They intentionally use `embed-1-quant` for cheap bulk and `embed-1-large` for premium. So interleaving is expected.

ashwin: short-term mitigation suggestions: set `max_batch_size` lower (e.g., 8) for that tenant, or configure per-model queue segregation. Also route quantized variants to a separate pool.

samantha: repro I ran: two clients, one hitting `embed-1-quant` (50 qps) and one hitting `embed-1-large@v2` (50 qps) with dynamic batching default settings. After ~40s we start seeing ~0.5-2% `embedding.dim_mismatch` errors and 95p latency spikes.

eng-support-bot: Escalation created: TICKET-4521 assigned to eng-runtime. SLA: 24h.

kai: plan: add a guard at batch assembly that validates `expected_output_dim` across queued items. If mismatch, move conflicting items to fallback queue and emit metric `batch_incompatible_count`. Will gate behind feature flag `reject_mixed_dim_batches`.

ashwin: also add a watch on alias rollout events — if an alias maps to a different artifact with different dim we should invalidate queued items or mark them incompatible.

miranda: need customer-facing mitigation text to send now.

samantha: suggested message: "We're investigating intermittent embedding dimension errors during high batching. Short-term: pin to a single variant or lower max_batch_size (we recommend 8). We're rolling out a runtime guard to prevent mixed-dimension batches."

kai: I'll push a canary with the guard today and flip the feature flag for a small host pool. Will add logs to make the incompatibility obvious (batch_id + dims).

ashwin: add an alert: `sum(batch_incompatible_count) / sum(batch_assembled_count) > 0.01` per 5m per pool.

samantha: I'll update the customer with the workaround + repro script and attach logs.

miranda: thanks — please post the canary link and ETA here so I can follow up with CS.

kai: ETA for canary rollout: 4 hours. Will post link once deployed.

samantha: great, keeping thread updated.
